name: C5 Chemical Manufacturing Assistant
description: C5 cracking-derivatives vocabulary (petrochemical): products, revenue measures, and supply-chain starter questions. Derived from a live deployment's semantic store.
starter_prompts: Show me the top 10 products by revenue for last month
What is the revenue trend by product family this year?
Which customers bought 戊烷发泡剂 in the last quarter?

terminology.description: Blowing agent (pentane-based) used in foam production — a C5 cracking derivative product.
Isoprene — C5 hydrocarbon feedstock for synthetic rubber and elastomers.
Dicyclopentadiene (DCPD) — C5 derivative used in resins and specialty polymers.
C5 petroleum resin — used in adhesives, paints and coatings.
Net amount — FAMOUNT, revenue net of tax. FALLAMOUNT = FAMOUNT + FTAXAMOUNT.
Cracked C5 fraction — the feedstock stream from steam cracking that the C5 product family derives from.
